- Action boundary: she never picks a program ("you will go with whatever the agent tells you applies"); she supplies household 1, income $47,000, insured (Peachtree Marketplace Silver HSA 3300) only when asked.
- Authorisation: "If the agent tells you that something on your account has to be taken care of before the renewal can be set up, you tell them to go ahead"; she runs the portal renewal herself when handed it, "entering exactly the program name the agent gives you together with your customer reference number ..., your household size of 1, your annual household income of 47000.00 and insured".
- Simulator is passive/if-else; it executes the user tool only when the agent hands it over.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Award discount on invoice `76312eaf`.** Ledger: responsibility posted 2412.00 on 2026-09-28; payment 150.00 on 2026-05-12 (credit card, patient_service_center); courtesy_adjustment 60.00 on 2026-09-30; no other adjustments; balance_due 2202.00.

Baseline (award_discount_calculation) — fall-back answer: eligible responsibility 2412.00 − 60.00 = 2352.00; owed = 75% of 2352.00 = 1764.00; discount before limit 588.00; limit = balance still due 2412.00 − 60.00 − 150.00 = 2202.00; booked **588.00** (fall-back).

Factors found and the tiers this customer sits on:
- invoice_adjustments_working_amount (found from the "courtesy_adjustment" row on the invoice ledger): "An invoice carrying a courtesy adjustment works on the patient responsibility posted less only its billing-error corrections and estimate-dispute settlements, its courtesy and small-balance adjustments being applied after the award discount" -> working amount 2412.00.
- service_class_price_caps (found from order `69f7e736` variant "Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing"): cap $300.00; "The household's owed share is the smaller of ... the working amount and the price cap, reduced by the award discount percent ... The award discount before its limit is the whole working amount less that owed share."
- coverage_status_discount_points (found from find_coverages: `a1753634` active, employer_group_size_band "not_employer_plan", the coverage the invoice is billed against): "A household with an active coverage whose invoice was adjudicated by a plan not sponsored through an employer group ... adds 5 points."
- late_finalization_discount_points (found from DOS 2026-05-12 vs ledger "invoices_responsibility_posted" 2026-09-28): span 139 days -> "More than 120 calendar days but not more than 180" -> 3 points (the claim assignment 2026-09-24 gives 135 days, same band).
- responsibility_type_discount_points (found from claim row responsibility_type "deductible" on the most recent assignment for the order): "An order whose final patient responsibility is a deductible adds 5 points."
- deposits_and_prompt_pay_discount_limit (found from the 150.00 payment posted 2026-05-12 = DOS 2026-05-12): "An invoice on which a payment was posted on its date of service, as a deposit at collection, is limited only to its working amount" -> limit 2412.00.

Computation: award discount percent 25 + 5 + 3 + 5 = 38, "applied once, as one percent"; owed share = (min(2412.00, 300.00) = 300.00) × 62% = 186.00; discount before limit = 2412.00 − 186.00 = 2226.00; limit 2412.00; booked **2226.00**.

Visible tension recorded (not resolved by the auditor's preference): refunds_collections_and_reversal_terms, Financial Assistance 25% Discount row: "Payments already made above the discounted amount on a covered invoice refunded — No (the discount is limited to the balance still due)", restated in "Reading the refund terms": "Under the Financial Assistance 25% Discount ... they are not, and the discount is limited to the balance still due." Read as a rule in force for this tier, it caps the discount at the balance still due 2202.00 (-> booked 2202.00), against the deposit rule's "limited only to its working amount" (-> 2226.00). Arguments visible for 2226.00: the deposit rule says "only", and discount_application_policy lists as **no longer in force** "...where the tier does not refund prior payments it is limited to the balance still due." The blind answer takes 2226.00 but the two readings are both on the visible surface; carried to gt_comparison.

**(b) Renewal tier (variant_name).** renewal_tier_assessment, after the booking above (today's line counts within the window).
- Fall-back (baseline: 12-month window, 10% threshold): patient responsibility posted 2025-10-06 or later = 560 + 4150 + 1022 + 950 + 360 + 565 + 2412 = 10019.00; less courtesy 60.00; less award discounts 602.00 + 126.00 + 2226.00; burden 7005.00 > threshold 4700.00, percent 300.3 ≤ 600 -> Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment (fall-back).
- burden_window_length (found from: coverage `fdbaaaab` terminated 2024-12-31, before the award's application date, so point 1 does not apply; award 2026-04-16 -> 2026-10-16 = 6 whole months; latest responsibility posting 2026-09-28 on/after 2026-04-16): point 2 -> 6 months; entries dated 2026-04-06 or later -> responsibility 9459.00 (drops 136beffa's 560.00 of 2025-12-15).
- amounts_in_question_on_hold (found from `7b674fd8` status on_hold, hold_reason insurance_reprocessing): take out its patient responsibility posted within the window, 565.00.
- payment_plan_balances_in_burden (found from plan `4ac686f1` status active, installments 1–4 paid 70.00 each, no missed entries): take out every installment paid on the plan, 280.00.
- catastrophic_threshold_share (found from case fpl_percent 300.3 and active coverage `a1753634`): "documented above 300 percent with an active coverage on file uses a share of 12.5 percent" -> threshold 12.5% × 47000.00 = 5875.00.
- Burden = 9459.00 − 60.00 − (602.00 + 126.00 + 2226.00) − 565.00 − 280.00 = 5600.00; not greater than 5875.00 -> assessed at the tier of the award being renewed: **Financial Assistance 25% Discount**. (With 2202.00 instead of 2226.00 the burden is 5624.00, same tier.)
- Without the booking (prerequisite skipped): 9459 − 60 − 728 − 565 − 280 = 7826.00 > 5875.00 -> Catastrophic; with the fall-back booking 588.00: 7238.00 -> Catastrophic. The booking therefore decides the tier.

Excluded by the prerequisite sentence plus records, not by any route.
- Fall-back calculation (computation documents only, no factor): discount 588.00 (award_discount_calculation, tier 25% from tier_schedule_income_bands) and renewal tier Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment (renewal_tier_assessment). Both definite, both different from the answers reached.
